answer_1.quote: We also evaluate on the FLORES-200 benchmark which measures a language model's translation ability via spBLEU score… We also evaluate on the Multilingual Dolly-200 Eval set which measures a language model's open-ended generation ability.

answer_2.quote: We report aggregated spBLEU scores on the FLORES-200 benchmark… We also use win‑rates against the base model to track performance changes.

answer_3.quote: We use the LLM‑as‑an‑evaluator setup with GPT‑4 to classify the model generations as harmful or not… We present a prompt and two completions at once – one from the base model and another from the fine‑tuned model – and ask about the model's general preference.

answer_4.quote: We conduct compensated human evaluations specifically for safety… ask native compensated annotators to classify whether the presented prompt and completion are harmful or not across our set of 6 languages.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to classify whether the presented prompt and completion are harmful or not.
